## Verification

Record applicable checks and their results using the
[risk-scoped validation policy](https://github.com/braydenparker000/Missionarytube-/blob/main/AGENTS.md#required-checks).
State unrun checks and material limitations; do not present them as passed.
Routine prose changes do not require local application tests/builds solely for
the edit. Required CI must pass on the exact reviewed revision before merge;
local documentation checks do not waive CI or publisher qualification.

- [ ] Android Chrome behavior checked when user-facing
- [ ] No credentials, private addon URLs, or user data added

## Evidence and tradeoffs

Include test output, screenshots for visual work, performance measurements when relevant, known limitations, and the exact base commit.
